title: auto endless run
script:
local rs = game:GetService("RunService")
local uis = game:GetService("UserInputService")
--[[local chr = game.Players.LocalPlayer.character
endlessfolder = chr.Name .. "Endless"
for i,v in pairs(workspace.wasshereallyintomeEndless.ModuleFolder:GetChildren()) do
    for i,v2 in pairs(v:GetChildren()) do
        if v2.Name == "Score" then
            chr.PrimaryPart.CFrame = v2.CFrame
        end
    end
end
--]]
lol = false
uis.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, e)
	if not e and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E and lol == false then
		lol = true
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E and lol == true then
	    lol = false
	end

end)

rs.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
if lol == true then
    local chr = game.Players.LocalPlayer.character
    endlessfolder = chr.Name .. "Endless"
    for i,v in pairs(workspace.wasshereallyintomeEndless.ModuleFolder:GetChildren()) do
        for i,v2 in pairs(v:GetChildren()) do
            if v2.Name == "Killbrick" then
                v2:Destroy()
            end
            if v2.Name == "Score" then
                chr.PrimaryPart.CFrame = v2.CFrame
            end
        end
    end
else return
end
    
end)
